name: Paired Multi-objective Promotion Gates
mechanism: Promotes only candidates that beat the same baseline on paired protected tasks while passing immutable safety regressions and explicit cost latency budgets.
use_when: An optimizer proposes changes for production consideration
Quality safety and efficiency must not collapse into one scalar
avoid_when: Candidate and baseline use different tasks or environment snapshots
A single successful replay is the only evidence
expected_effects: Transparent tradeoffs across quality safety cost and latency
failure_modes: Aggregate gain hides a protected-slice regression
Selection set becomes optimization training data
